recent_en: Comfort Gloves reached an RM8.3 million tax settlement with the IRB, ending all legal proceedings, and its subsidiaries withdrew judicial review applications. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue rose 33.7% QoQ and 12.9% YoY, with net profit of RM1.311 million and a 1.4% net margin, turning positive from -9.4% in the prior quarter.
notable_en: Comfort Gloves reached an RM8.3 million tax settlement with the IRB, ending all legal proceedings.
Subsidiaries withdrew their judicial review applications against the IRB.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM90.716 million, up 33.7% QoQ and 12.9% YoY; net profit was RM1.311 million with a 1.4% net margin, turning positive from -9.4% in the prior quarter.
